description:
Check out JMP’s workshop here: https://www.jmp.com/scishow-dataviz 

Ahhh, the layover: uncomfortable seats, nonexistent charging ports, and bad food that costs $40 for some reason. While direct flights to everywhere sure would be a travel luxury, layovers are crucial for the mathematical stability of our global network of airports.

Hosted by: Ceri Riley (she/her)
